method: If the chickpeas, drained is meant to be warm, sort that first; otherwise keep chilled fillings properly cold. Get the pan properly hot, add the chickpeas, drained and let it take on a little colour before you start moving it around.
Build the club flavour into the filling or dressing before it hits the bread, then taste it. It should taste good on its own before it becomes a sandwich.
Lay out the bread, spread right to the edges and add the wetter ingredients away from the bread where you can — nobody asked for a soggy lunch.
Pile in the chickpeas, drained, add the fresh bits for crunch, close it up and press gently so it holds together. Eat now, or wrap and chill promptly.
